lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized in approximately twelve distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The clusters within the mid-flank region exhibit a regular relative spatial distribution, forming a coarse rectangular grid-like arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the columns of circular clusters. Each high-luminance blob is positioned as an anchor node centered within these vertical bands, forming a lattice structure across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side, indicating raised structural ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of small high-luminance blobs. These features are predominantly clustered in the anterior and basal regions of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is present on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin, deviating from a smooth parabolic curve.
other_distinctive_markers: Several elongated, low-luminance objects are visible in the water column adjacent to the pectoral fin and along the ventral-lateral flank.
